correctness.rationale: A direct change to centered mean and orthogonal deviations yields the √m tube Jacobian. Endpoint rescaling determines power h and a finite J_m(a) for ma<m−1; at ma=m−1 the mean-coordinate t^{-1} integral yields exactly half a logarithm per critical endpoint. The regular-density formula uses an integrable beta power. Exact conditional noise variance and differentiated ridge risk prove the unique oracle tuning. Stieltjes transform asymptotics give the stated risk equivalents. Code checked 81 exact algebra/scaling relations; finite simulation is not used as an infinite proof.
